description: Use to compare the models and systems on one job on one day. Leave date out for the newest day. Returns every model's and system's published result that day, NL;NL Labs' own models and systems marked. On a job with two tests, the answer says what they are. Extract's documents days also carry invented, missed and unreadable counts. Fields: cost_per_1000_right_usd and ipd are exact; cost_shown and ipd_shown are how the page shows them. assembled_by_us is 1 when the answer was assembled by us, else 0. A count marked "not published for this model" is not published for that model.
name: get_day_results
title: All models on one day
